Guan et al. (2020) optimal stopping — local TEH/PICS copy

Paper:
  Guan, M., Stokes, R., Vandekerckhove, J., & Lee, M. D. (2020).
  A cognitive modeling analysis of risk in sequential choice tasks.
  Judgment and Decision Making, 15(5), 823–850.
  DOI: https://doi.org/10.1017/s1930297500007956

Authoritative source:
  https://github.com/maimeguan/RiskProject
  Data/OptimalStopping.mat

Do NOT use mdlee/behavioralDataRepository trials.csv for this task:
  that CSV is missing value5–value8 for sequenceLength=8.

Setup:
  python scripts/setup_external_guan_2020_stopping.py
